While the sources use HTTP(S) URLs and checksums are provided via `b2sums`, missing or skipped checksums are not relevant for this gate, as no downloading or verification occurs during `makepkg --printsrcinfo`. There are no command substitutions, function calls, or executable statements at the global scope that would lead to unintended code execution during parsing.

Thus, sourcing this PKGBUILD for metadata extraction does not trigger any malicious behavior.
</details>
